title: Dotenv Generator
description: Create, update, or remove environment variables across a project's .env* files, optionally syncing the same change to other projects.

projects.description: Additional project names to apply the same change to, e.g. an app that consumes this feature

section.description: Grouped section header the variables belong under (default: MISC)

set.description: Variables to create or update, as KEY=VALUE pairs

skipEnvConfig.description: Skip keeping lib/config/env.ts's zod schema and process.env accessors in sync with the same variables being set/unset (as z.string(); edit env.ts directly if a var needs stricter validation)

files.description: Additional .env.<suffix> files to target, e.g. ['local', 'prod']. .env and .env.example are always included.

all.description: Target every .env* file that already exists in the project root instead of a fixed list

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)
